description: Header file defining structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for a test protocol module within the Zephyr networking stack, including JSON serialization and packet handling functions.

methods.name: tp_input
methods.description: Processes incoming network packets for the test protocol.

methods.name: tp_out
methods.description: Outputs a test protocol message to the network interface.

methods.name: tp_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory for test protocol data.

methods.name: tp_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for test protocol data.

methods.name: tp_calloc
methods.description: Allocates and zero-initializes memory for test protocol data.

methods.name: tp_mem_stat
methods.description: Reports memory usage statistics for test protocol.

methods.name: tp_nbuf_alloc
methods.description: Allocates network buffer for test protocol.

methods.name: tp_nbuf_clone
methods.description: Clones a network buffer.

methods.name: tp_nbuf_unref
methods.description: Unreferences a network buffer.

methods.name: tp_nbuf_stat
methods.description: Reports network buffer statistics.

methods.name: tp_pkt_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a network packet.

methods.name: tp_pkt_clone
methods.description: Clones a network packet.

methods.name: tp_pkt_unref
methods.description: Unreferences a network packet.

methods.name: tp_pkt_stat
methods.description: Reports network packet statistics.

methods.name: tp_seq_track
methods.description: Tracks sequence numbers for the test protocol.

methods.name: tp_seq_stat
methods.description: Reports sequence number tracking statistics.

methods.name: json_to_tp
methods.description: Converts JSON data to a tp structure.

methods.name: json_decode_msg
methods.description: Decodes a message string into a tp_type enum.

methods.name: json_to_tp_new
methods.description: Converts JSON data to a tp_new structure.

methods.name: tp_encode
methods.description: Encodes a tp structure into JSON.

methods.name: tp_new_to_json
methods.description: Converts a tp_new structure into JSON.

methods.name: tp_new_find_and_apply
methods.description: Finds and applies a key-value pair in tp_new.

methods.name: tp_out
methods.description: Sends a message with key-value data over network.

methods.name: tp_tap_input
methods.description: Processes input packets for tap.

methods.name: tp_basename
methods.description: Extracts basename from file path.

methods.description: Converts hex data to string.
